props.name: aria-label
props.description: The block's accessible name. A block named here or through `aria-labelledby` is a `region` landmark. An unnamed block has no role. The block is a tab stop unless the consumer passes `tabIndex`, so a keyboard user can scroll it.

props.name: code
props.description: The source text, highlighted as JavaScript and JSX. Pass raw text, not HTML. The highlighter escapes it, so markup shows as text. The block paints no fill, so its `--sh-*` syntax colors read on the fill behind it. They reach 4.5:1 on `background`, `card`, `card-soft`, `dialog`, `panel` and `muted` in every theme and scheme. Place the block on one of those fills, such as inside a `bg-card` or `bg-muted` container. On other fills, such as `primary-soft` or `foreground`, some syntax colors fall under 4.5:1.
